record.paper: Multicolor list Ramsey numbers grow exponentially

dossier_meta.paper: Multicolor list Ramsey numbers grow exponentially
dossier_meta.statement_text: It would be interesting to determine $\lim_{k\to\infty} R_\ell(H,k)^{1/k}$, even in just the case $H = K_3$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorems 1 and 2 together give $\frac{1}{e}\cdot 2^k \leq R_\ell(K_3,k) \leq (4+o(1))^k$, but the exact exponential constant is unknown. The authors note that their results do not even establish that the limit $\lim_{k\to\infty} R_\ell(H,k)^{1/k}$ exists.
